title: Customer Service & Sales Advisor
description:

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Location: Huddersfield, West Yorkshire (Office-Based)
Salary: 35,000 Basic + Bonus
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

An Exciting Opportunity in a Specialist Industry

Are you a confident, commercially minded sales professional who enjoys building relationships, delivering excellent customer service and turning enquiries into sales?

This company is looking for an enthusiastic Internal Sales Executive to join its team in Huddersfield.

Specialising in the supply of industrial door and loading bay parts to the trade, this company supports engineers, installers and service companies with the components they need to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in internal sales, technical parts or B2 B customer service to join a specialist business where product knowledge, customer relationships and a proactive sales approach are key to success.

Experience within the industrial door industry would be a real advantage, but we're equally interested in candidates from other technical sales or parts backgrounds.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive, you'll be a key point of contact for trade customers, helping them source the right products while maximising sales opportunities and delivering an outstanding level of service.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Handling incoming sales enquiries via telephone and email from engineers, installers and trade customers.
- Proactively following up quotations, developing customer relationships and converting enquiries into orders.
- Identifying the correct industrial door and loading bay components, offering suitable alternatives where appropriate.
- Preparing accurate, competitive quotations and processing customer orders.
- Working closely with purchasing, warehouse and logistics teams to ensure orders are fulfilled efficiently.
- Providing customers with product availability, pricing and delivery information.
- Identifying opportunities to increase sales from existing customers and develop repeat business.
- Resolving customer queries and maintaining accurate records using internal CRM and order management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and confident speaking with customers, with the commercial awareness to spot opportunities and turn conversations into sales.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in internal sales, B2 B sales, trade counter sales or a technical parts environment.
- Excellent telephone communication skills and a confident, customer-focused approach.
- A proactive sales mentality with the ability to follow up opportunities and close orders.
- Strong attention to detail when dealing with product specifications, quotations and part numbers.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries in a busy environment.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, CRM systems or order processing software.

Industry knowledge would be particularly desirable, especially experience with products such as:
- Industrial roller shutters and sectional overhead doors.
- High-speed and fast-action doors.
- Dock levellers and loading bay equipment.
- Door motors, control panels and automation components.
- Safety edges, seals, sensors and associated spare parts.

However, candidates with experience selling engineering components, electrical parts, mechanical spares or other technical products are also encouraged to apply.

What's On Offer?
- 35,000 basic salary plus bonus.
- Monday to Friday working hours - no weekends.
- Permanent, office-based position in Huddersfield.
- Specialist product training and ongoing support.
- Opportunity to develop your technical knowledge and sales expertise.
- A varied role combining customer service, relationship management and commercial sales.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Internal Sales Executive, Parts Advisor or technically minded sales professional looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note, if your application is suitable, one of our consultants will call you within 5 working days. If you have not heard from us within this time, your application has unfortunately been unsuccessful, however we will keep your details on our talent management system to consider you for future opportunities.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator

Location: Wetherby Area
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:30pm
Benefits: 22 days annual leave including 8 bank holidays, car parking, company pension and social events

About the Role

If you're interested in this opportunity and would like to be considered for the role, we'd be delighted to hear from you. Please apply with your CV today or contact Helen at Unity Resourcing for further information.

title: Telesales Closer
description:
Telesales Closer / Appointment Setter

Location: Bradford
Salary: 28,000 basic + commission + optional overtime
Hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm Office-based

The Opportunity

Marmon Lift Recruitment is looking for an experienced Telesales Closer / Appointment Setter to join a growing sales team based in Bradford.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is confident on the phone, commercially driven and knows how to turn warm leads and opportunities into results.

You don't need specific industry experience. We're looking for someone with a proven track record in telesales, appointment setting, lead conversion or closing, who can build rapport quickly, overcome objections and confidently ask for the sale.

You'll be dealing with warm enquiries, following up opportunities and speaking to customers who have already shown an interest - so this is not a cold-calling heavy role.

Package & Benefits
- 28,000 basic salary
- 25 commission per completed sale
- Additional commission available through warranty sales
- Opportunity to earn extra through appointment setting
- Optional evening and weekend work for additional earning potential
- Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm
- Office-based position in Bradford
- Opportunity to progress and take on greater responsibility
- Potential to develop and build a dedicated telesales closing team

The Person We're Looking For

We're looking for a confident and motivated sales closer who enjoys picking up the phone and getting results.

You should have:
- Proven telesales, telephone sales or appointment-setting experience
- A strong track record of converting leads into sales or appointments
- Excellent communication and rapport-building skills
- Confidence handling objections and difficult conversations
- A natural ability to ask for the sale and close deals
- A competitive, target-driven attitude
- The ability to follow up opportunities persistently without being pushy
- Good organisation and CRM experience
- The confidence to work independently and take ownership of opportunities
- A genuine desire to earn through commission

Industry experience is not essential. We're far more interested in your sales ability, attitude and results.

Key Responsibilities
- Contact warm leads and convert opportunities into completed sales
- Close sales over the phone
- Follow up customers who have received quotes but haven't yet proceeded
- Handle inbound and outbound sales calls
- Identify customer needs and recommend the appropriate solution
- Overcome objections and negotiate confidently
- Upsell warranties and additional services where appropriate
- Set appointments and generate additional sales opportunities
- Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-up activity
- Consistently work towards and exceed sales targets

Who Would Suit This Role?

This could suit an experienced:

Telesales Executive Sales Closer Telephone Sales Executive Appointment Setter Sales Advisor Lead Generator Inside Sales Executive B2 C Sales Executive B2 B Sales Executive

If you're currently in a sales role where you're booking appointments, qualifying leads or getting customers over the line, we'd like to hear from you.

Please apply today or send your CV

title: Account Executive SaaS Fintech
description:
High earnings potential and a genine opportunity to make a real difference will attract an experienced SaaS Account Executive to this Fintech SaaS provider to uncover new business sales opportunities for financial services software with mid-market and enterprise organisations. This is a well-established financial technology services provider with an ever-evolving SaaS platform. Of course, this platform has AI embedded. This is a land and expand Account Executive role with new logo acquisition required. There is opportunity to hunt for new business within a portfolio of existing accounts. The role is highly autonomous, identifying and engaging with senior operations, project managers, IT and finance directors within B2 B and B2 C organisations in the UK and overseas.

The Organisation:
- A Fintech SaaS provider using AI technology to plug gaps in customer journeys to increase revenues and drive efficiency for many organisations
- Huge growth opportunity for this technology within numerous mid-market and enterprise verticals
- Very strong use case and demonstrable ROI for this SaaS platform, along with numerous case studies and reference sites
- Excellent support from marketing, internal lead generation and partner network to add opportunities to the top of the sales funnel
- A flexible, supportive, culture that rewards success
- Privately owned, highly entrepreneurial, always innovating their SaaS platform, strong history of growth
- Career pathways for future progression
- Hybrid Office/Home working culture

The Person:
- Minimum of 5 years experience in SaaS sales, primarily focused on new logo acquisition. Some experience selling new solutions into existing accounts would also be a bonus.
- Experience of complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-stage sales methodologies to win new logo clients
- Proactive, resourceful, determined and capable of building trusting relationships at all levels with numerous different prospect personas
- Must have a demonstrable record of success in New Business sales. Account Management revenue growth would be advantageous. Winning deals worth £15k ARR - £50k ARR
- Experience of Selling Fintech SaaS solutions would be highly desirable
- Experience of hybrid working or working from home is preferable. Working from the office in South Yorkshire is possible

This is a privately owned, growing business with significant financial backing. Your achievements will be recognised and well rewarded.

The package includes a Basic salary of approximately £55,000 to £65,000. The OTE will be £95,000 to £130,000. There will be no cap on earnings. There is huge potential for career development within this entrepreneurial organisation. The package could be flexible for exceptional candidates.

Applications are invited from individuals that match the above description and are both based in the UK and eligible to work in the UK.

Autus HR has been contracted to search for, assess and select Sales Professionals who will be successful in this role. Due to the specific requirements of this role, only a small percentage of all applications will be invited to progress through the process, however we will respond to every application we receive. Not being successful for this role does not exclude you from applying for other opportunities.

For further information please contact Paul Roberts.
